title: Buffer/overlay: schools within a mile (live OpenStreetMap)
query: How many schools does OpenStreetMap have within 1 mile of 41.9231 N, 87.7093 W?

expected_why.count_within_mile: Overpass https://overpass.private.coffee/api/interpreter at run time, nwr amenity=school

answer:
**OpenStreetMap has 19 schools within 1 mile of the point (41.9231 N, 87.7093 W)** — located in the Logan Square / Avondale area of Chicago.

I searched OpenStreetMap for `amenity=school` features in the surrounding area (84 schools found in the broader bounding box) and computed the great-circle distance from the point to each school's location. The 19 schools within 1 mile, nearest first:
